changes.title: Charlie Kirk's alleged killer will stand trial for aggravated murder
changes.summary: Judge Tony Graf said prosecutors have enough evidence against Tyler Robinson to put the 23-year-old on trial on a charge that could see him face the death penalty.

changes.title: Accused Charlie Kirk shooter Tyler Robinson must stand trial, judge rules
changes.summary: A judge ruled Tuesday that accused Charlie Kirk shooter Tyler Robinson will stand trial in the killing of the late conservative activist, where he could face the death penalty.

changes.title: Judge rules that the trial of Tyler Robinson in Charlie Kirk’s killing can go forward

changes.title: U.S. Says It Revoked More Than 175,000 Visas Under Trump
